description: This PHP source file defines the 'Online' report controller within the Opencart admin panel. It manages the display and retrieval of online customer data, including pagination and filtering by customer and IP address, and renders the corresponding views.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class handling online customer reports within the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and renders the online customers report page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading required components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Responds with the online customers list, using getList to retrieve data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and compiles the list of online customers, applying filters, pagination, and formatting before returning the view.
